ops.text:
P8 round 1 complete + adjudicated. Workflow wf_a30cf56c-b8b: 4 impl lanes all STATUS:done, 8 codex review passes, 1.6M subagent tokens, ~2.4h. Branches (none pushed): captain-hook v14-migration@c4c3461e (29 files, rebased onto 9.30.0 mid-lane), cc-steer v14-migration@80dada3d (663 tests green; brief was stale — no path dep/CI clones existed, but the real surface was repo-wide v13 async API), cc-sentiment v14-migration@d948b07 (wip/cc-transcript-v13-nlp had already landed on main — FF, no rebase; 836 tests, refuter-reproduced), cc-context v14-migration@996c11a2 (bench was on v11, not 13.x; 200 tests green).

Adjudication (fix workflow wf_fd8bf529-c42 dispatched): captain-hook — 6 items (stress/ still async vs sync store ×4 sites, FallbackCall unhandled in events/decisions/docs, 2 de-async'd test fakes, conductor noise match anchored to prefix [fix.py case-insensitive stop-marker ACCEPTED — filterspec owns marker semantics], small stale texts). cc-steer — 5 items (open_readonly weak-ref P2 crash reproduced [plain sqlite3.Connection vs v14 WeakKeyDictionary invariant], split TurnRefs drop typed previews, render_version 3 gates typed rendering [v2 stays provenance-independent], v3 renderer preview-sequence-driven not regex-paired, stale test annotation). cc-sentiment — docs/CI-label staleness only; IMPORTANT correction: lane claimed server aggregation unaffected — FALSE, subagent_count + edit ratios ARE uploaded/averaged server-side; deltas adjudicated acceptable-and-deliberate, changelog entry required. cc-context — clean except two UPSTREAM gaps: (1) CommandLine.commands omits argument-position command substitutions (echo $(ccx ...) → only echo; x=$(ccx ...) works — verified empirically on 14.0.0), (2) PrintMessage lacks id/usage which trajectory.py accounting needs. Both → cc-transcript v14.1.0 additive lane in the same fix workflow. consistency_section stays raw deliberately (needs an upstream lenient print-parse mode — tracked as an open upstream design item, not silently dropped). cc-steer negatives now scrub the steer span (v13 leak fixed — flag to user); cc-sentiment metric deltas are server-visible (changelog).

Release order after fix verification: cc-steer merge→main push; captain-hook merge+FF+tag-guard→tag→PyPI; cc-sentiment push→auto-publish (gates first); v14.1.0 stamp+tag (me); cc-context finishes trajectory/integrity after 14.1.0 live, then merge→main.
